unit.zh: 惠帝即位，賈后擅權，加充廟備六佾之樂，母郭為宜城君。

translations.literal: When Emperor Hui assumed the throne, Empress Jia monopolized authority; Chong's temple was augmented with six-row music; mother Guo became Lady of Yicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Hui, Empress Jia dominated politics: Chong's shrine gained six rows of ritual dancers and Lady Guo received the title lady of Yicheng.

surroundingUnits.zh: 其以謐為魯公世孫，以嗣其國。

translations.literal: Let Mi be Duke of Lu's lineage grandson, to succeed its state.
translations.idiomatic: Let Han Mi inherit the duchy of Lu as Chong's designated grandson.

surroundingUnits.zh: 自非功如太宰，始封無後如太宰，所取必以己自出不如太宰，皆不得以為比。」

translations.literal: Unless merit be like the Grand Tutor, first enfeoffment lacking heirs like the Grand Tutor, those taken must issue from oneself not inferior to the Grand Tutor—none may take this as precedent."
translations.idiomatic: Unless merit equals the grand tutor's, unless the founding line fails as his did, and unless the heir springs from one's own issue as Han Mi did, no one may cite this case."

surroundingUnits.zh: 及下禮官議充諡，博士秦秀議諡曰荒，帝不納。

translations.literal: When it came to handing down to ritual officials deliberating Chong's posthumous title, Erudite Qin Xiu deliberated posthumous title as wasteful; the Emperor did not adopt.
translations.idiomatic: When ritual officers debated Chong's posthumous name, Erudite Qin Xiu proposed "Desolate"; the emperor rejected it.

surroundingUnits.zh: 博士段暢希旨，建議諡曰武，帝乃從之。

translations.literal: Erudite Duan Chang hoped for imperial intention, proposed deliberating posthumous title as martial; the Emperor thereupon followed it.
translations.idiomatic: Erudite Duan Chang, angling for imperial favor, suggested "Martial," which the emperor accepted.

surroundingUnits.zh: 自充薨至葬，賻賜二千萬。

translations.literal: From Chong's death until burial, burial gifts totaled twenty million.
translations.idiomatic: Between his death and burial the court lavished twenty million cash in funeral grants.

surroundingUnits.zh: 惠帝即位，賈后擅權，加充廟備六佾之樂，母郭為宜城君。

translations.literal: When Emperor Hui assumed the throne, Empress Jia monopolized authority; Chong's temple was augmented with six-row music; mother Guo became Lady of Yicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Hui, Empress Jia dominated politics: Chong's shrine gained six rows of ritual dancers and Lady Guo received the title lady of Yicheng.

surroundingUnits.zh: 及郭氏亡，諡曰宣，特加殊禮。

translations.literal: When the Guo clan lady died, her posthumous title was Declarer; exceptionally added special rites.
translations.idiomatic: When Lady Guo died she received the posthumous name "Declarative" and honors beyond the usual.

translations.literal: People of the time mocked this, yet none dared speak.

surroundingUnits.zh: 初，充前妻李氏淑美有才行，生二女褒、裕，褒一名荃，裕一名浚。

translations.literal: Earlier, Chong's former wife Lady Li was virtuous and beautiful, possessing talent and conduct; she bore two daughters Bao and Yu; Bao had another name Quan; Yu had another name Jun.
translations.idiomatic: Chong's first wife, Lady Li, was talented and lovely; she bore two daughters—Bao, also called Quan, and Yu, also called Jun.
